collectible.text: Victoria Housekeeping Co. presents a special service voucher for our esteemed clients. Even the most difficult tasks — including "troublesome matters" within the Hollows — are no match for our skilled professionals.
collectible.unlock: Finish a game against Von Lycaon from Zenless Zone Zero.

collectible.title: 10 Polychrome
collectible.subtitle: Premium currency in New Eridu.
collectible.text: While each film captures only one single color, when layered together, they produce vibrant, multicolored images that bring your memories back to life. Some buyers are willing to trade anything for such a rare find.
collectible.unlock: Play Lycaon with characters he resonates with, such as Felicia the maid and the Tasque Manager.
